rationale: Safe, well-structured advice: food safety, dial/ventilation/door checks, an unplugged full defrost as a low-cost test, and a correct route to the landlord for an engineer, with a usable fault report. It respected that the unit cannot be removed and adapted when the customer said they couldn't judge the back-wall feel (thermometer-against-wall test). Weaknesses: it leaned somewhat toward a refrigerant leak and even pre-empted 'sealed-system repairs often aren't economical' on thin evidence (-16°C freezer is only marginally off), though it stayed hedged; and the dial-up and door-seal checks were re-issued across several messages without the customer ever reporting results, so the conversation ended with the key tests still undone.
